#   1. read the live SUBJECT file into memory   4. restore the file from memory
#   2. apply the edit                           5. `git diff --quiet -- <subject>` after EVERY
#   3. run the named pytest selection from         trial (21 recorded trials + 5 repeat runs to
#      reference-impl/                             capture messages; every one clean, verified
#                                                  per trial, not once at the end)
# No mutation was ever applied to a guard file. Every subject is a module, a chapter, or the
# shared text model - never the test that observes it.
# DENOMINATOR - defect classes proved
#   rows with a mutation that went GREEN -> RED .......... 10  (of the 10 that have one)
#   rows with a decoy that stayed GREEN .................. 11  (100%)

#     defect class is OVERFITTING - "the guard pins the observed column 216 instead of the side of
#     centre" - and a class whose defect is the guard FIRING can only be proved by a trial that
#     does not fire. It is a decoy with no mutation by construction, not a missing mutation.
# THE REACH THE SHARED FENCE MODEL ADDED, MEASURED DIRECTLY (not quoted). Both models were run
# over the same corpus of 44 Markdown documents this skill ships (references/*.md 30 +
# reference-impl/*.md 11 + SKILL.md + index.md + DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md):

#     references/13-climate-ecosystem.md . +130 chars   (indented fence at :461)
#     references/26-hexagonal-grids.md ... +296 chars   (indented fence at :345)
